newsitem.title: CHINA: China Xinjiang region opens new oil and gas well.
newsitem.headline: China Xinjiang region opens new oil and gas well.

text.p: China has opened a new oil and natural gas well in the northwestern region of Xinjiang's Jungar basin, the Xinhua Daily Telegraph said on Friday.
The new well was finished on October 30 and had yielded 1,025 tonnes of crude oil and 272,000 cubic metres of natural gas a day up to November 26, the newspaper said.
Going down to a depth of 4,957 metres, it is the deepest well of its type currently in production in China, the report said. It gave no further details.
